title: Hybrid Cell Analysis System to Assess Structural and Contractile Changes of Human iPSC-Derived Cardiomyocytes for Preclinical Cardiac Risk Evaluation
protocol: Open the vacuum-sealed packaging and take out the 96-well plate.
Transfer 2.75 mL of EHS gel ready-to-use solution into a sterile centrifuge tube.
Add 8.25 mL of DPBS with Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ to the centrifuge tube containing EHS gel.
Mix the EHS gel coating solution carefully.
Transfer the coating solution into a sterile reagent reservoir placed in the lab automation robot.
Add 100 μL of the coating solution per well using the program "ADD100µL".
Place the lid back onto the 96-well plate and incubate for 3 h at 37 °C.
Count the cells using a manual counting chamber.
Adjust the cell count according to manufacturer instructions, resulting in 11 x 10^6 cells/11 mL for an entire 96-well plate.
Remove EHS gel solution from wells with the lab automation robot using program "REMOVE100µL".
Transfer cell suspension (11 mL total) into a sterile reagent reservoir placed in the lab automation robot.
Seed the cells with 100 µL/well using program "CELLS_ADD100µL".
Immediately transfer the flexible 96-well plate to the incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2, humidity-controlled).
Warm at least 22 mL of cardiomyocyte maintenance medium per plate to 37 °C in a 50 mL centrifuge tube, 18-24 h after seeding.
Transfer fresh medium (at least 22 mL) into a sterile reagent reservoir and place next to the robot.
Perform medium removal with program "REMOVE100µL".
Exchange waste reagent reservoir for one containing fresh medium.
Dispense 200 µL of fresh medium per well with program "ADD100µL".
Repeat dispensing step twice to reach a final volume of 200 µL/well.
Transfer the plate back into the incubator immediately after medium exchange.
Perform a medium exchange every other day until compound addition, using 200 µL/well.
Warm at least 22 mL of assay buffer for one flexible 96-well plate.
Transfer the fresh medium into a sterile reagent reservoir and leave it next to the lab automation robot.
Place an empty reagent reservoir in the robot and perform medium removal.
Exchange the reagent reservoir containing waste medium with the one containing fresh medium.
Dispense 200 µL/well of fresh medium.
Transfer the flexible plate back into the incubator immediately after medium exchange.
Prepare working solution per compound at 4x concentration in a sterile regular 96-deep well plate using assay buffer.
Transfer the 96-deep well plate containing the compound solution to the incubator for at least 1 h.
Transfer the plate to the respective measurement device 1 hour before performing a baseline measurement.
Open Edit Protocol in the control software and select the respective measurement mode contractility or impedance/EFP.
Define the sweep duration (length of one measurement) and the repetition interval (time between measurements).
Save the protocol number.
Select Start protocol > Continue and fill in the requested fields.
Finally, select Start measurement.
Perform a minimum of three baseline measurements in 5 min intervals shortly before compound addition.
Remove 50 μL of the assay buffer from each well without removing the flexible 96-well plate from the measurement device.
Add 50 µL of the 4x concentrated compound solution into each well of the plate according to the measurement plan.
Select Add region marker and define the compound plate layout and the volume of the compound solution after compound addition.
Finally, select Proceed with standard measurement or Proceed with measurement series according to the experimental plan.
Measure sweeps using recording software with user-defined length and repetition interval.
Capture signal parameters like amplitude, beat rate, pulse width automatically with analysis software.
Calculate the mean beat including standard deviation based on one sweep data.
Define contractility/IMP/EFP parameters for calculation and display by analysis software.
Calculate dose-response curve and IC50/EC50 for each compound using analysis software.
Export raw data and analysis results in various formats easily.
Generate automatic data reports to summarize and archive experimental results.
